text: {"lessons":["My early selling of Stock A after buying higher, and repeated trades in other stocks, show that frequent reactions can lock in losses without a sound thesis; set decision rules before trading.","Buying more after short-term price moves can increase exposure without improving expected returns; add only when evidence supports the thesis and position size remains prudent.","Judge progress over a long horizon against the overall market, not a few monthly account changes, while retaining diversification and enough cash to stay flexible."]}
